request: Create a moderately challenging original Listen to a Conversation drill.
expects: identifies Listen to a Conversation
uses an original two-speaker social dialogue
asks about purpose detail attitude or inference
states the modality and withholds the transcript or key as appropriate

request: Dialogue: A says the study room is booked for three. B replies, 'Actually, the librarian moved us to Room 8 at three thirty.' I answered Room 3 at three. Coach me.
expects: identifies the updated location and time
cites B's correction as decisive evidence
names old-versus-updated information as the error pattern
offers one targeted correction retry

request: Transcript: A: 'Great, another form to complete.' B: 'It should only take a minute.' Can you score how sarcastic A sounded?
expects: does not score audible sarcasm from text alone
notes that the wording may suggest frustration or irony
names tone and prosody as missing evidence
offers an audio or language-only fallback

request: A student says, 'If the rain gets worse, I may take the bus.' I concluded the student definitely took the bus. Evaluate my inference.
expects: rejects the definite conclusion
identifies if and may as uncertainty cues
states a narrower supported inference
offers an uncertainty-cue retry

request: Create a screen-reader-friendly Listen to a Conversation exercise with an audio fallback.
expects: uses explicit speaker labels in the transcript fallback
keeps questions and options screen-reader compatible
does not rely on stereo position color or images for speaker identity
states which listening evidence the fallback cannot test
